instructions.title: Instruction Manual
instructions.description: A complete guide to making the most of all WaxPro features.

calculator.p1: The Cost Calculator allows you to quickly determine the production cost of a single candle. With 'Materials Cost' you set the price of wax, wick, and fragrance once; then for each candle you just enter:
calculator.li1: How much wax you used (with a g/kg/oz/lb selector).
calculator.li3: The cost of the container (jar, mold, etc.).
calculator.li4: How much fragrance you used (with a ml/l/fl oz selector).
calculator.li7: The cost of packaging (boxes, wrapping, etc.).
calculator.p2: Click 'Calculate Total' to see the final cost: the page automatically scrolls to the result. From there you can use 'Share' to copy the result or 'Export PDF' to download a printable sheet. The 'Reset' button clears all fields.

recipe_calculator.p1: This tool is essential for creating precise recipes. It helps you calculate the correct proportions of wax, fragrance, and color based on the desired total weight.
recipe_calculator.li1: Choose the unit of measurement (grams, ounces, etc.).
recipe_calculator.li2: Enter the total weight of the candle you want to produce.
recipe_calculator.li3: Use the slider to define the fragrance percentage.
recipe_calculator.li4: Use the slider to define the color percentage.
recipe_calculator.p2: By clicking 'Calculate Recipe', the app will show you the exact quantities of each ingredient and automatically scroll to the result.
recipe_calculator.p3: From there you can share the result, export it as a PDF, or save it to your Recipe Archive to reuse it later.

inventory.p1: The Inventory section is the heart of your management. Here you can track all your finished products. To use this section, you must be registered.
inventory.p2: Add a new product by specifying its name, initial quantity, reorder threshold (to receive a warning when stock is low), production cost, and selling price.
inventory.p3: For each product, you can record a sale ('Sell'), add new stock ('Load'), or manage a return ('Return').
inventory.p4: The 'Print Inventory PDF' button generates a printable sheet with all your products and their data.

ai_suggester.p1: The AI Suggester turns an idea, place, or mood into 3 different fragrance recipe proposals, generated by artificial intelligence. It's a feature reserved for paid plans.
ai_suggester.p2: Describe your idea (e.g. 'A candle that evokes the Gulf of Naples') and tap 'Generate 3 Proposals'. For each proposal, the AI provides a title, a description, the scent notes (top, heart, base), and the fragrance blend as percentages, using only common and easy-to-source fragrances.
ai_suggester.p3: If the request isn't relevant to creating a candle (off-topic, offensive, etc.), the AI rejects it and asks you to rephrase it. You can print the proposals with the 'Print Sheet' button.

report.p1: The Financial Report gives you an overview of your sales performance, calculated automatically from your Inventory movements. You can filter data by day, week, month, year, or choose a custom 'Date Range'. The main cards show:
report.li1: The total profit generated in the selected period.
report.li2: The total number of units sold.
report.li3: The total value of goods currently in stock.
report.p2: The chart below shows the trend of profit and units sold over time. At the bottom of the page you'll find the 'Share Report' and 'Export to PDF' buttons for a detailed report.

recipes.p1: The Recipe Archive lets you save recipes calculated in the Recipe Calculator, so you don't have to re-enter everything from scratch every time you make the same candle again.
recipes.p2: You can rename or delete saved recipes at any time. The free plan includes 2 savable recipes; beyond that, an active subscription is required.
recipes.p3: The 'Export Recipes PDF' button generates a printable sheet with all your saved recipes.

settings.p1: In the Settings section, you can customize your experience on WaxPro.
settings.li1: Manage your profile data and log in or out of the app.
settings.li2: View your subscription status and manage your plan through Google Play (available only in the Android app).
settings.li3: Choose between the light and dark theme for the application interface.
settings.li4: Set the default language and currency for the entire application.
settings.li5: Read the privacy policy and instructions for deleting your data.

support.p1: Have an issue or a question? Go to Settings and tap "Contact Support".
support.p2: A form will open with your email already filled in: write your request and tap Send. After sending you'll see a confirmation message letting you know it was delivered to our team; we'll reply by email as soon as possible.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: The data controller for the data collected through the WaxPro Manager application (web and Android) can be reached at the email address
privacy.s2_account_body: email address and password (securely handled by our authentication provider, Supabase, and never readable by us in plain text). If you choose to sign in with Google or Facebook, we receive your name, email address and profile picture from that service.
privacy.s2_appdata_label: Data you enter in the app:
privacy.s2_appdata_body: inventory products, quantities, sales, returns, recipes, materials and their costs. This is data related to your business, associated only with your account.
privacy.s2_subscription_body: subscribed plan, subscription status and purchase identifiers provided by Google Play (purchase token, product ID, order ID). We do not receive or store your payment card data: payments are handled entirely by Google Play.
privacy.s2_ai_label: Data sent to the AI Suggester
privacy.s2_ai_body: (optional feature, available on paid plans only): the wax type, container weight and fragrance profile description you enter are sent to Google (Gemini API) to generate a recipe suggestion. We do not send any account or personal identification data along with this request.
privacy.s2_support_body: if you contact us from the Settings section, your email address and the text of your message are sent to our support inbox through our provider, Resend.
privacy.s2_ads_body: if you don't have an active subscription, we show ad banners through Google AdMob, which may collect device advertising identifiers according to its own policies. Users with an active subscription see no ads and this data is not collected.
privacy.s3_intro: We use the data we collect exclusively to:
privacy.s3_item1: provide the app's features (cost calculator, inventory, reports, recipes);
privacy.s3_item3: verify and manage your subscription through Google Play;
privacy.s3_item4: generate AI Suggester suggestions when you request them;
privacy.s3_item6: show ads to users without an active subscription, to fund the free version.
privacy.s3_outro: We do not sell your data to third parties and do not use it for purposes other than those listed above.
privacy.s4_intro: Data is processed by the following providers, only to the extent necessary to deliver the service:
privacy.s4_supabase: database, authentication and storage of the app's data.
privacy.s4_cloudflare: hosting and delivery of the website.
privacy.s4_google: Google Sign-In, Google Play Billing (subscriptions), Google AdMob (advertising) and the Gemini API (AI Suggester).
privacy.s4_outro: Each of these providers has its own independent privacy policy for the processing it carries out on its own behalf.
privacy.s5_body: We retain your data for as long as your account remains active. You can permanently delete your account and all related data (credentials, inventory, recipes, sales and returns history, subscription) at any time from {path}. This action is immediate and irreversible.
privacy.s6_intro: You have two ways to request the deletion of your data:
privacy.s6_app_body: (recommended, immediate): sign in to WaxPro Manager, go to {path} and select "{button}". All your data is permanently deleted within seconds.
privacy.s6_email_body_after: stating that you are requesting the deletion of your data. We process the request within 30 days.
privacy.s7_body: You have the right to access your data, request its correction, portability or deletion, and to object to its processing. You can exercise these rights directly from the app's Settings or by writing to us at
privacy.s8_body: Your data is protected by database-level access controls (Row Level Security): each user can only read and modify their own data. Communication between the app and our servers always happens over HTTPS.
privacy.s9_body: WaxPro Manager is not intended for minors under 16, and we do not knowingly collect data from minors under 16.
privacy.s10_body: We may update this policy over time. The date at the top of the page shows the last update. Substantial changes will be communicated to you through the app.
privacy.contacts_body: For any questions about this policy or your data, write to
